alerts.title: Next water turn Saturday 21 Nov
alerts.why: Wheat is tillering. Soil at 94%, above the 50% refill point. No rain in the forecast.
steps: Water on your turn Saturday, early morning.
alerts.voice: الأرض فيها مية كفاية لحد دورك يوم السبت.

alerts.title: Little rust weather this week
alerts.why: 0 of the last 7 nights were foggy and humid. Nights 11 to 15 °C. Your variety can catch rust, so keep watching.
steps: From January, walk the field once a week.
alerts.source: Rust weather index, NASA POWER and Open-Meteo humidity and dew point

alerts.title: New satellite image: 5 squares got less green
alerts.why: 5 of your 12 squares lost 0.08 or more greenness since the last clear image.
alerts.voice: فيه حتة في الأرض خضارها قل. روح بص عليها.

alerts.title: Weeding starts around 22 Nov
alerts.why: Weeks 3 to 6 after sowing are the critical weed-free period for wheat sown 1 Nov.
steps: Hoe or hand weed before fertilizing.
alerts.voice: نضّف الأرض من الحشايش لحد يوم 13.

alerts.title: No heat risk this week
alerts.why: Highs of 26 to 28 °C. Wheat is not yet at a heat sensitive stage.
